newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan sets five pct budget deficit target.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan sets five pct budget deficit target.

text.p: Pakistan's policy-making National Economic Council on Thursday set a budget deficit target of five percent of gross domestic product (GDP) for fiscal 1997/98 (July/June) against an estimated 6.1 percent in 1996/97.
"We are targetting for a five percent deficit," state Planning Commission deputy chairman Hafeez Pasha told a news conference after a council meeting.
He said Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif's government also planned to cut the inflation rate to nine percent from a level of more than 12 percent estimated for 1996/97.
Pasha said the government hoped to achieve this by containing monetary expansion and faster agricultural growth.
